text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Un, deux, trois,
un, deux, trois!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Your posture's wavering! Focus on the feeling
of being suspended from the ceiling by a single thread!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A thread... from the heavens.
...Like this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Rose Kingdom taking ballet lessons
from Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Don't just use your arms—express
your emotions all the way to your fingertips!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Focus your awareness... all the way to your fingertips.
As if letting... pure vitality burst forth!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while later, I spotted her learning
theatrical opera choreography from T.M. Opera O this time.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san, like this, like so!
Even while dancing, never neglect your appoggio!
This is the very pinnacle of opera!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see—maintaining breath support.
Like this, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time after that,
she was receiving lessons in traditional Japanese dance from Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The essence of traditional Japanese dance is to watch, imitate, and commit to memory.
Please watch my movements closely and try to follow along.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Like flowing water.
And looking up toward the moon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And at long last—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Rose-chan!
More, more—be totally cute and lovely with your whole body♡
Now, give me that sparkling smile☆

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us go.
Sparkling with――a radiant smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They were overdoing the lessons, to be frank.
Thinking that, I just couldn't help but...
choice_data_list: You are so earnest, Lady Rose...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—So you saw me. Forgive me
for practicing in secret like this.
choice_data_list: Aren't you pushing yourself a bit too hard...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A little strain is unavoidable.
To display the supreme brilliance, one must—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Unless I know a hundred forms of brilliance.
For the world holds—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There are dances of various kinds,
each possessing its own unique beauty.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Without mastering them,
how could I ever dance like a true rose?
choice_data_list: Every single one turned out fantastic!
I'll look for unique dances too!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I see, thank you.
If you say so, I shall accept it gladly.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Though—that one in particular proved quite a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...A dazzling smile.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Something felt slightly amiss...
I shall make another attempt in due time.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. There are limits to what one
can learn from the academy's students, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: If you come across anything of interest, please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No matter what manner of dance it may be,
I shall master it without fail.
